# Ankr Agent RPC MCP Server

> Token-efficient blockchain data for AI agents. Routed MCP tools over Ankr RPC with TORPC response compression: tier 1 renames the fields, turns hex into decimal and drops the service fields (logsBloom, cumulativeGasUsed, header roots); tier 2 adds the ABI decode, so ERC-20/contract calls and event logs come back as named arguments. Measured 2026-07-17 over 21 methods and 25 Ethereum mainnet blocks, token-weighted, o200k_base over the full HTTP body: 48.4% fewer tokens at tier 2 and 35.3% at tier 1. Decode-heavy reads save the most (eth_getTransactionByHash 69.0%, eth_getTransactionReceipt 64.5%, eth_getBlockReceipts 60.3%, eth_getLogs 28.9%).

## Install
- Local (stdio): `npx -y @w3tech.io/agent-rpc-mcp` with env `ANKR_API_KEY`
- Get a key: https://www.ankr.com/rpc/

## Tools
- describeMethods: param shape and a worked example per JSON-RPC method, plus whether this key may call it on this chain (probe:true asks the node)
- expandResult: continue a paged result using an opaque cursor
- getAccountBalance: multi-chain balances, prose format, capped and reports what it withheld (AAPI)
- getBalances: native coin (tier 1) + ERC-20 token balances with USD (AAPI)
- getBlock: block header (+ optional decoded txs), TORPC tier 2
- getInteractions: which chains an address has interacted with, cross-chain (AAPI)
- getLogs: event logs, decoded, chunk-scanned over wide ranges and paged, TORPC tier 2
- getNFTs: NFTs held by an address (AAPI)
- getTokenHolders: holders of an ERC-20, paged (AAPI)
- getTokenPrice: USD price with chain, asset and as_of provenance
- getTokenPriceHistory: historical price series for a token (AAPI)
- getTransaction: transaction + receipt by hash, ABI-decoded, TORPC tier 2
- getWalletActivity: address transaction history (AAPI), paged via cursor
- listChains: supported chains, max TORPC tier, AAPI availability
- resolveContract: is-contract, best-effort ERC-20 metadata, EIP-1967 proxy (tier-0 passthrough)
- rpcCall: any read method not covered by a routed tool. It keeps NO list of permitted reads: it refuses writes (broadcast, signing, tx building, node/wallet admin, mutating verbs) and forwards everything else, so which reads exist is decided per chain by the endpoint's blockchain schema and your tenant
- searchChain: resolve a tx/block hash, 0x address, or block number

## Protocol
- TORPC tier negotiation: request header `Accept-Token-Tier: 0|1|2`; response header `Token-Tier`. A JSON-RPC batch gets ONE header for the whole array, carrying the MINIMUM tier applied across its elements; v1 has no per-element signal, so read each element's tier from its shape.
- Tier 0 = passthrough. Tier 1 = field rename + hex->decimal + the service fields dropped (logsBloom, cumulativeGasUsed, contractAddress, type, the header roots). Tier 2 = tier 1 plus the ABI decode: each log becomes {contract, event, args} and calldata becomes a decoded function with named args.
- The tier is negotiated PER CALL and is not guaranteed: a response over the proxy's compression budget comes back at tier 0, and so does any method the proxy does not compress. Read `_meta.tier` on the result before looking for decoded fields: snake_case names and decimal numbers prove tier 1 or better, only `args`/`event`/`function` prove tier 2. Some tools ADDITIONALLY set `tier_degraded: true` in the body with a note on how to narrow the request; not all of them do, so `_meta.tier` is the signal that always works.
- Every tool result carries `_meta.tier` (the applied tier) and `_meta.token_count` (a real o200k_base count of the emitted text).

## Discovery
- TORPC descriptor (protocol version, negotiation headers, tier meanings, method lists): https://mcp.ankr.com/.well-known/torpc.json, also served at https://rpc.ankr.com/.well-known/torpc.json
- Agent card (ERC-8004 registration file: name, description, MCP endpoints, x402Support: false): https://mcp.ankr.com/.well-known/agent-card.json, also served at https://rpc.ankr.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Both ship in the npm package under static/.well-known/. The served copy is authoritative; packaged copies can lag it.

## Spec & source
- Spec: https://github.com/w3tech/torpc (CC0-1.0), narrated at https://www.ankr.com/docs/agentic-rpc/torpc/
- Reference decoder: @w3tech.io/torpc-decoder (Apache-2.0), source at https://github.com/w3tech/torpc-js under codec/
- Measured token savings: https://github.com/w3tech/torpc-js/blob/main/bench/results/live-token-savings-2026-07-17.md
- Docs: https://www.ankr.com/docs/agentic-rpc/agent-rpc-mcp/ and https://www.ankr.com/docs/rpc-service/getting-started/management-mcp/
- This server: https://github.com/w3tech/agent-rpc-mcp-public (MIT), package https://www.npmjs.com/package/@w3tech.io/agent-rpc-mcp
